body: Can you please provide a short code example?

Sorry for that.
Would you prefer that I send you the test ?
Yes it would be great, minimal reproduction as possible

Hi, I added a simple test that reproduces it.
I am trying it on MSSQL but I believe it is the same in all DB's.

Please take a look

Thanks
It was a bug and fixed it, thx for report and test

Thank you !!!!
Would it be possible to explain why we need the property path set for virtual columns ?
Since I am touching code, it would be useful to understand this case.
For embedded entities it is clear, we need the path. But for virtual it is not.
Maybe a small example ....

its a bit hard to explain but I'll try.

We need to build column property path because of two reasons:
* embeddeds, for example "post.counters.likes"
* referenced in relations columns, for example "post.category.id"

When we create a relation it defines a new column (lets say categoryId) and marks it as virtual.
Virtual means this column exist in the database but does not exist in entity defined by user.
This column has propertyPath equal to "category.id".

But when we create a relation and a column called exactly the same as relation suppose to create a column (we create a categoryId column inside our entity) orm does not create any extra column, thus does not mark anything as virtual. And such column propertyPath is just like any other column's property paths are - its equal to simply "categoryId".

Its really hard to explain, I wish to show you this process in a debug mode...

No its clear !!!! I have seen the code, just wanted to validate it with you !!!
Thanks, great code btw

On the other hand, why you did not just add the property in the entity (since it already exists in db) and skip the virtual part ? Maybe just keep a flag that the column is auto-created for informational reasons, I don't believe it makes any difference for the user - developer...

Anyways, we are good !!!! If this "nested" path can be used for joins in statements as is, then its a killer !!! (Hope it does, I will need it) !!!!
